name: Grok Voice Agent Builder
desc: No-code console for configuring production voice agents that run on Grok Voice.
desc_zh: 无需写代码即可配置运行在 Grok Voice 上的生产级语音智能体控制台。
solves: Voice stacks usually bolt together speech-to-text, a model and text-to-speech from three vendors; this is one interface on a speech-to-speech path.
solves_zh: 语音方案通常要把三家厂商的识别、模型和合成拼起来；这里是一个界面走完语音到语音的整条路。
best_for: You need a phone agent that answers real calls tonight and already own the phone number over SIP.
best_for_zh: 今晚就要一个能接真实电话的语音智能体，而号码已经在 SIP 上时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — x.ai/news directory）。 Beta. Telephony, knowledge retrieval, tools, guardrails, MCPs and observability ship together; existing phone numbers can be brought over SIP and clients connected over WebSocket. The homepage x.ai/voice returns 403 to curl (bot guard). 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Voice Agent Builder」，加上产品名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://x.ai/news/grok-voice-agent-builder 官网未直接确认（403）。
